rule.operation: 10*log10(max(mean(abs(H_scaled)**2 over each five exported subcarriers), epsilon_power))
rule.scaling: Original author/Halperin sqrt(SNR) scaling, same RSSI/AGC/noise handling as prepare_data.py
rule.bands: Three RX antennas x six consecutive exported-subcarrier groups of five = 18 streams
rule.resampling: Linear interpolation to 500 equally spaced valid packet-index positions per record; physical duration/timestamp gaps are not preserved
rule.fitting: None. No pooled source or target statistics. Each record transformed independently by the fixed formula.
rule.labels: No labels or model predictions used by conversion; manifest file order and hash receipts only.

units: dB of mean scaled channel power, dimensionless reference; not calibrated received power in dBm. Original geometric-amplitude and this power-average feature have different meanings even though both are in dB.
provenance: Alsaify et al., Mendeley Data v2, DOI 10.17632/v38wjmz6f6.2, CC BY 4.0. This is a changed derived representation, not new acquisition.
